narrative.intro: Noridian Healthcare Solutions is a federal contractor with $329M in obligations in FY2026 to date. Noridian Healthcare Solutions received 7 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $47M. Noridian Healthcare Solutions saw obligations up 39.2% year over year. Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers is the largest market for Noridian Healthcare Solutions with $292M in FY2026 to date. Noridian Healthcare Solutions also received $36.9M in All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services and $0 in Computer Systems Design Services in the current period. Noridian Healthcare Solutions obligations have varied by year: FY21 $324M, FY22 $291M, FY23 $154M, FY24 $252M, FY25 $236M, and FY26 $329M. Noridian Healthcare Solutions current-year totals are fiscal year to date and represent partial-year results.
